title: Official regulatory information — candidate source
notes: Candidate only. Specific medicine search/database endpoint, available fields, update frequency, bulk access and reuse permission have not yet been verified.

title: Egyptian Drug Database (eg-drugs) — community-maintained dataset and public API
notes: Repository README states 27,617+ medicines marketed in Egypt and provides CSV/JSON/SQLite/SQL plus a public REST API. Dataset is stated to be CC BY 4.0 with attribution. This is not an official EDA source; underlying field-level provenance, completeness, correctness, price freshness and API uptime have not been independently audited. Website search integration uses the documented public API and must display attribution and third-party-data caveat.
